title: German-Style Fish Pilaf
description: A hearty German-inspired fish pilaf dish that combines pilaf with the flavors of German cuisine. Perfect for a comforting and satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add fish and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add quaint and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add pilaf and cook until lightly toasted, about 2-3 minutes.
Add 2 cups water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and cover the skillet.
Simmer for 10-12 minutes or until pilaf is tender.
Stir in german and season with salt and pepper to taste.
